title: Faraday Future Intelligent Electric Inc. 8-K Filing
summary: Faraday Future Intelligent Electric Inc. filed an 8-K reporting multiple board resignations and appointments: Matthias Aydt resigned as director on April 14, 2026; Jie (Jay) Sheng and Chui Tin Mok resigned as directors on April 16, 2026. The board appointed Jiawei (Jerry) Wang, Xiao (Lucky) Jiang, and Kevin Chen as new directors on April 16, 2026. This is a standard corporate governance filing with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Matthias Aydt resigned as director and notified of intent to resign as Global Co-CEO for personal reasons on April 14, 2026
Jie (Jay) Sheng resigned as director effective April 16, 2026; may continue in advisory capacity
Chui Tin Mok resigned as director effective April 16, 2026; continues as executive officer and Head of FF Middle East
FF Top Holding LLC nominated Xiao (Lucky) Jiang, Kevin Chen, and Jiawei (Jerry) Wang to the Board
Kevin Chen serves as Chief Economist and CIO of Horizon Financial and CIO of CoinBridge
Three new directors appointed on April 16, 2026: Jerry Wang, Lucky Jiang, and Kevin Chen
